methods: Inspection only. Source geometry built in memory; existing STEP inspected/rendered. No production CAD regenerated. Motor paths sampled at 48 positions per side per route; lid forward positions sampled every 0.2 mm. No physical or structural testing.

L.procedure: wheel/stub removed, face screws removed; motor inward 12.1 mm then down 40 mm; housing/cap and body shell retained

R.procedure: wheel/stub removed, face screws removed; motor inward 12.1 mm then down 40 mm; housing/cap and body shell retained

L.excluded: body assembly/electronics/shell, serviced wheel/stub, face screws, flexible pigtail reserves; housing/cap and opposite rigid motor retained

R.excluded: body assembly/electronics/shell, serviced wheel/stub, face screws, flexible pigtail reserves; housing/cap and opposite rigid motor retained
